shift.heading: For teams that need distance from routine and deeper reconnection.

items.question: Where do the retreats happen?
items.answer: At nature venues within reach of Gurgaon/Delhi-NCR. We match the site to your group size and budget.

items.question: How long are they?
items.answer: Half-day, full-day or up to two days with overnight stay. Longer formats go deeper on bonding.

items.question: What group size works?
items.answer: 8–30. Small enough for real sharing circles, big enough for team energy.

items.question: Do you handle logistics and meals?
items.answer: We coordinate flow, facilitation and sattvic meals; travel/stay is arranged with you or your admin team.

items.question: What activities are included?
items.answer: Forest bathing, outdoor sound healing, sunrise yoga, breathwork and team sharing circles.

items.question: Is it physically demanding?
items.answer: No — gentle, restorative pacing. Walks are easy and optional.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: Quoted per head depending on venue, nights and group size. Get a tailored number.

items.question: How far ahead should we plan?
items.answer: 2–3 weeks minimum so venue and logistics lock in cleanly.
